name: Brandywine Creek Campground
note: Mostly seasonal: the operator's site map marks 32 of its 55 numbered RV sites as occupied by seasonal campers, and the rest sell by the night, week or month; no tents. Open April 1 to November 1, reservations by phone or email (no online booking). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site (brandywinecreekcampground.com, 'Updated 03/10/2026', read 2026-10-21): 2026 rates page posts RV Site (water/electric/sewer) nightly $55, weekly $350, monthly $750 ($900 Jun-Aug), seasonal by call, phone (610) 942-9950, no application/lease/waitlist and no minimum stay; map page marks 32 of 55 sites red = 'occupied by seasonal campers', leaving 23 (42%) for transients; all RV sites full hook-up 30/50 A on 'large level pads', Esri World_Imagery shows 35-45 ft trailers on the loop pads; no homes or lots sold -> real transient RV campground passing long-stay tests 2-5; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: operator's campground map (img/map/bcc_clr.jpg) puts every RV pad inside the site loops, with the outer loop road running between the pads and East Branch Brandywine Creek (apart from four small unlabelled blocks between the road and the creek; the park no longer takes tents). Esri World_Imagery at 40.0626,-75.7422 and 40.0611,-75.7433 (rendered, ~0.3 m): the creek is hidden under a continuous forested strip east and south of the loops; the creek-side pads sit ~36-47 m from the OSM-mapped river bank with the loop road plus that woodland between, so neither access nor an unscreened view is shown -> continuous treeline buffer, default down. The fishing pond is a small private pond at the west end with no pads at it. No dam involved.
fees_source: https://www.brandywinecreekcampground.com/rates.php (read 2026-10-21): '2026 Rates ... based on 2 adults and 2 children', RV Site (water, electric, sewer, cable) Nightly $55.00, Weekly $350.00, Monthly $750 (Jun-Aug: $900) plus electric, Seasonal call for price; extra adult $10/night and extra child $5/night beyond 2+2 only; no resort or grounds fee. One site type, so $55 is the base weeknight rate.
flags: No online booking engine: rate is the operator's own posted 2026 nightly rate; reservations by phone/email only.
Seasonal share comes from the operator's map overlay (red site numbers = seasonal); the page is dated 2026-03-10 but the overlay's own date is not stated.
Prior verdict skipped it only for the $55 published rate (> $50); price gate now lifted.
Creek runs along the campground but behind the loop road and a wooded strip; AWH may want to eyeball the east-edge pads (sites near the entrance) in leaf-off imagery for a possible creekview.
